text.en:
The following subdivisions known as Sun Valley, Marimar, Mote Villa de Monsod, Sta. Ana
and Continental Village, in Barangay La Huerta in the Municipality of Parañaque, Metro Manila, is hereby
detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute into a distinct and independent barangay which
created to be known as barangay Sun Valley without affecting in any manner the legal existence of the mother
barangay La Huerta.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
barangays, shall be applicable to barangay Sun Valley.

The present elective barangay officials of Barangay La Huerta shall continue to perform their
duties as such officials in the newly created Barangay Sun Valley until the barangay officials of said barangay
shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until their successors
shall have been elected in the regular elections for barangay officials following the issuance of this Decree and
shall have qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive officers and
employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the government personnel of the barangay Sun
Valley shall be appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Barangay Sun Valley in the
obligations, funds, assets and other property of Barangay La Huerta shall be transferred by the President to the
newly created barangay upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations, inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-eight.
